diagnosticQuestionsForNextDesign: Can Routeability be retrained or redesigned for implicit current-22 routable questions without relaxing its frozen-v0.4 threshold post hoc or sacrificing non-route safety?
Can Fallback Identity eliminate the reject-all/multiple-admission structural failure mode while preserving one global acceptance threshold and all-22 coverage?
Would a mutually exclusive 22-class identity distribution plus one global confidence threshold provide cleaner uniqueness semantics than 22 independent sigmoid admissions?
What fresh calibration population is required to measure both implicit known-route recall and all three non-route safety subtypes before any new threshold is selected?
How should attribution be preserved so Routeability and Fallback changes can be evaluated separately rather than bundled into an uninterpretable revision?
designOrder: freeze next-candidate architecture before generating any fresh training/calibration data
prefer minimal attributable revisions and separate Routeability work from Fallback Identity work when experimentally feasible
seal all fresh calibration/development artifacts before first scoring
retain the v0.4 independent report solely as immutable evaluation evidence, not as a fixture source
